anatomy.demo: 身份凭证→服务端验证→登录状态
anatomy.demo_en: Identity credentials→Server verification→Login status

parts.desc: 密码、一次性验证码或第三方平台返回的身份结果
parts.desc_en: Password, one-time verification code or identity result returned by third-party platform

parts.desc: 服务端核对凭证、限速并处理失败，不相信前端自己宣布登录成功
parts.desc_en: The server checks the credentials, speed limit and handles the failure. It does not believe that the front end announces that the login is successful.

parts.desc: 用安全 Cookie 或受保护 Token 让后续请求能证明是同一位用户
parts.desc_en: Use secure cookies or protected tokens to allow subsequent requests to prove it is the same user

variants.when: 传统网站常见，浏览器自动携带 Cookie
variants.when_en: Common for web apps; browsers send the cookie automatically.

variants.when: 移动端或独立 API 常见
variants.when_en: Common for mobile apps and standalone APIs.

variants.when: 把身份验证交给成熟平台
variants.when_en: Delegate identity proof to a trusted provider.

use.t: 优先采用成熟身份服务或框架方案，不自己发明密码系统
在 HTTPS 下为登录 Cookie 设置 Secure、HttpOnly，并按跨站需求选择 SameSite
登录失败使用模糊提示，避免泄露账号是否存在
退出登录时让服务端会话或令牌真正失效

dont.t: 数据库明文保存密码：一旦数据泄露，受影响记录的密码会直接暴露
把 JWT 当加密保险箱：内容通常只是编码，仍可能被读到
只在前端 localStorage 里写 isLoggedIn=true
登录接口没有限速：容易被批量猜密码

lessonPractice.title: 有人带着有效登录态访问“我的订单”。系统首先该确认什么？

options.label: 确认这次请求对应的是哪个已登录用户
options.feedback: 对。身份认证回答“你是谁”；之后才能决定这个用户能看什么。

options.label: 只要页面上显示了用户头像，就认为已经登录
options.feedback: 头像是前端显示，不是服务端可验证的身份凭据。

options.label: 先根据用户是管理员还是普通成员决定身份
options.feedback: 角色属于权限判断，前提是已经可靠地识别出用户。

en.title: A request with a valid session opens My Orders. What must the system establish first?

options.label: Which signed-in user this request belongs to
options.feedback: Correct. Authentication answers who the requester is before the system can decide what they may see.

options.label: That the page displays a user avatar
options.feedback: An avatar is browser display, not server-verifiable identity.

options.label: Whether the user is an admin or a member
options.feedback: A role is an authorization decision made after identity is established.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 订单页目前只根据前端传来的 userId 取数据。请改为从已验证的登录态取得当前用户，再查询其订单。分别用已登录和未登录状态访问：前者只能看到自己的订单，后者应被要求登录。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: The orders page currently trusts a userId sent by the browser. Change it to obtain the current user from verified sign-in state before querying orders. Test signed-in and signed-out access: the first must show only that user’s orders, and the second must require sign-in.

scenes: 使用 GitHub / Google 登录

use.t: Recover account access through a controlled process

dont.t: Treat a user ID sent by the browser as proof of identity
Use long-lived tokens with no revocation plan
Reveal whether a private account exists through detailed errors

usageMocks.auth-use-provider:
成熟方案提供常见认证能力
密码 / 验证码→身份服务→安全会话
usageMocks.auth-use-cookie:
登录 Cookie 的常见保护
HttpOnly脚本不可读Secure只走 HTTPSSameSite限制跨站携带
usageMocks.auth-use-error:
失败提示不泄露账号状态
不推荐该邮箱不存在 → 推荐账号或密码错误
usageMocks.auth-use-logout:
退出要让凭证真正失效
会话有效→服务端撤销→再次请求 401
usageMocks.auth-dont-password:
密码不能明文入库
email: oil@example.compassword: 123456
数据库泄露后，明文存储的密码会直接暴露
usageMocks.auth-dont-jwt:
JWT 内容通常可以解码查看
header.payload.signaturepayload: { "email": "oil@example.com" }
不要在里面放密码、令牌等敏感信息
usageMocks.auth-dont-local:
改本地变量不能证明身份
控制台修改isLoggedIn = true → 服务端检查没有有效会话 · 401
usageMocks.auth-dont-rate:
缺少限速的登录接口
1 分钟10,000 次尝试结果可持续猜密码
